# attention awareness

> A free Mac app that blocks addictive feed apps and websites on an iPhone for good. It supervises an iPhone on iOS 26 or earlier and installs a locked profile, without erasing the iPhone. It does not support iOS 27 yet; on iOS 27 the manual guide is the way. No app is installed on the iPhone. There is also a free browser extension that hides the addictive feeds on YouTube, Instagram and X, a manual guide, a profile builder and a blog. Everything is free. The Mac app is open source under AGPL-3.0. The browser extension and the website are MIT.

## Product

- [Home page](https://attentionawareness.com/): The free Mac app, how it works, and answers to common questions.
- [Manual guide](https://attentionawareness.com/guide): Supervise your iPhone with Apple Configurator on a Mac, then install a profile that blocks addictive feeds. It is free, and it erases the iPhone.
- [Profile builder](https://attentionawareness.com/build): Pick the apps and websites to block on a supervised iPhone, then download a signed profile.
- [Open numbers](https://attentionawareness.com/open): The real numbers of the website, shown to everyone: visitors, page views, bounce rate, session length, where visitors come from and Mac downloads.
- [Extension privacy](https://attentionawareness.com/extension/privacy): The browser extension hides addictive feeds with CSS. It collects nothing.

## Blog

- [How to block porn on an iPhone for good](https://attentionawareness.com/blog/block-adult-websites-iphone): Turn on Apple's adult website filter in Screen Time, and lock it on a supervised iPhone so it cannot be switched off.
- [How to block an app on an iPhone so it can't come back](https://attentionawareness.com/blog/block-any-app-iphone): Six ways to block an app on an iPhone, and what each way leaves open.
- [iPhone parental controls your child can't turn off](https://attentionawareness.com/blog/iphone-parental-controls-kids-cannot-turn-off): Apple's parental controls set up the right way, where kids get around them, and a locked profile they cannot remove.
- [How to turn your iPhone into a dumb phone](https://attentionawareness.com/blog/turn-iphone-into-dumbphone): Five ways to make an iPhone a dumb phone, compared. Keep camera, maps, bank and messages.
- [Why Screen Time doesn't work, and what does](https://attentionawareness.com/blog/why-screen-time-does-not-work): Why Screen Time limits fail for adults, and the one setup with no button to skip them.
- [Free Apple MDM, or no MDM: lock down work iPhones](https://attentionawareness.com/blog/work-iphones-without-mdm): When a small business needs Apple's free MDM, and how to lock 1 to 20 work iPhones by cable without one.
